scope: Scoped bounded project collection component for #674; human/API/MCP consumers and runtime configuration remain unfinished
controlled_cases: foreign receiving account refused before network
invalid page/route identifiers refused before task reads
every returned task independently verified against selected project
titles and numeric priority come from the scoped task response, not graph metadata
foreign, outside-page and duplicate dependency edges withheld without their identifiers/content
empty observations, task failures and degraded/missing graphs kept distinct
credential refusal after task collection discards the entire observation
fresh numeric pages bounded to at most eight task candidates, four concurrent pipelines
reported dependencies never become conflict or strict-roadmap admission verdicts
mutation_classification: Deliberate Go overlays, not historical bugs or native fleet failures; real source unchanged

native.selection: Private explicit user-supplied fleet-root context; not a WebMux product binding

limitations: No product configuration loader, HTTP endpoint, browser view or MCP consumer is enabled by this component
Native fleet-root test selection does not enroll or identify a live WebMux project
Numeric pages are fresh observations and can miss/repeat rows as upstream data changes
No atomic snapshot, current participation, complete inventory, conflict exclusion or roadmap ordering proof
Operator/caller must qualify transport and recheck current binding revision before releasing cached/in-flight data
Source/roadmap and WebMux session links remain unlinked; freshness and non-read operations unqualified
